newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Akzo Nobel cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Akzo Nobel cut.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analysts Michael Stone, Isabel Brandt and John Van de Graaff have cut their rating for Dutch chemical group Akzo Nobel NV to hold from buy.
-- They wrote in an April 28 report that they had made the downgrade because of "disappointing" first quarter results.
-- "We are reducing our earnings estimates, by seven percent for the current year and by 12 percent for 1998, to reflect a more cautious view on pharmaceuticals and fibers."
-- The company's American Depositary Receipts were up 1/2 to 64-3/8 in New York.
